title: Mood Score Weather Impact Best Weather Window
dataSources: Weather-station readings (`weatherstation:reading`), daily weather-impact rollups (`personalweather:daily`), sleep correlation records (`personalweather:sleep`), step correlation records (`personalweather:steps`), mood correlation records (`personalweather:mood`).
app: Local weather-station readings correlated with personal sleep, steps, mood, and outdoor-activity summaries in Splunk via scripted inputs and daily rollups.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalweather:mood
| stats avg(mood_score) as avg_metric count as days by condition_bucket
| sort - avg_metric
description: Ranks weather-condition buckets by average mood score so your best-performing conditions are easy to spot.
value: This helps turn personal intuition into a decision aid for when to run, work, walk, or recover.
implementation: Define readable condition buckets such as cool-dry, warm-humid, windy, or rainy during the daily rollup stage.
visualization: Leaderboard of condition buckets by average mood score.
grandmaExplanation: It lists which kinds of weather usually line up with your best mood score.
